title: Staff Backend Engineer - Phone Billing
description:
Job Summary Were looking for a Staff Engineer to lead the technical direction and evolution of Phone Billing, one of the most critical components of HighLevels communication platform. Phone Billing sits at the intersection of product usage, infrastructure, and revenue - it is responsible for accurately metering and monetising usage across LC Phone products, including voice, messages, phone numbers, and other communication services. The scale and criticality of this system make billing correctness non-negotiable. Every communication event can have a financial implication, and a single billing error can impact revenue, customer trust, and financial reconciliation at the same time. The platform processes 100M+ events daily across 15+ services, with billing workflows that need to remain accurate and reliable despite retries, duplicate events, delayed events, provider inconsistencies, partial failures, and continuously evolving pricing models. As a Staff Engineer, youll own the architecture, scalability, reliability, and technical strategy of the Phone Billing platform. Youll solve complex distributed-systems problems around usage metering, rating, charging, idempotency, reconciliation, credits, refunds, adjustments, provider cost tracking, and billing lifecycle management. Youll also drive the architectural evolution required to support significantly higher volumes without compromising financial accuracy or system performance. A key part of the role will be building billing systems that are correct by design - ensuring that every billable event is accounted for exactly once from a business perspective, even when the underlying infrastructure operates with retries, at-least-once delivery, asynchronous processing, and failures. Youll establish robust reconciliation mechanisms between HighLevels internal usage data, provider-level usage, and customer invoices, with strong observability and auditability to quickly identify and resolve discrepancies. Youll work closely with Engineering Managers, Product Managers, Finance, and other Staff Engineers to define pricing and billing architecture, while partnering across Phone, WhatsApp, CPaaS, and provider-integration teams. Youll influence technical decisions beyond a single team, establish engineering standards, identify systemic technical debt, and drive long-term improvements in reliability, cost efficiency, data architecture, and operational excellence. The broader Phone Core ecosystem includes CPaaS platform services, Trust Compliance, and phone number provisioning, giving this role significant architectural influence across the communication platform. Your primary focus, however, will be making Phone Billing a highly scalable, financially accurate, resilient, observable, and extensible platform capable of supporting the next 10x growth of HighLevels communication business. Responsibilities Own the end-to-end technical health of Phone Billing - proactively identify architectural bottlenecks, correctness and reliability risks, and technical debt; define and drive the roadmap to improve billing accuracy, reconciliation, scalability, observability, and cost efficiency as the platform scales to 10x its current volume. Drive 1-2 high-impact initiatives end-to-end - take ownership from problem definition and technical discovery through architecture, implementation, rollout, and measurement, ensuring the initiatives deliver measurable improvements to Phone Billing in areas such as accuracy, reliability, scalability, or cost efficiency. Architect for massive scale: Own the high-level architecture and scaling decisions for core Phone platform components, including CPaaS abstractions, provider adapters, and shared messaging/voice APIs that support billions of monthly events. Own Phone Billing end to end: usage metering, rating, reserve/commit lifecycle, idempotency, reconciliation, and audit trails for the Phone channels - with zero tolerance for double-charging or lost usage Lead the evolution of Revenue Growth into a configuration-driven, rules-based platform that adapts to new regulatory and carrier requirements without invasive engineering change Work hands-on with technologies like NestJS, Firestore, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis, Queuing Systems, Data Warehousing Systems and Service Mesh-based microservices Drive high-concurrency innovation: Lead the design and execution of cross-cutting initiatives to improve reliability, latency, and throughput across time-sensitive APIs and workflows serving millions of businesses. Drive observability and resilience by evolving our monitoring, alerting (Prometheus/Grafana), and incident response strategies - including the financial invariants that must be alerted on, not just the technical ones Leverage LLMs and AI tools to write, refactor, test, and debug code efficiently - while implementing guardrails to reduce hallucination and boost reliability Partner with product, infra, security, finance and legal teams to ensure data integrity, access control, and compliance across phone services Develop EM I leaders and senior engineers, build leadership pipeline, succession planning and raise the hiring bar 

 Disclaimer: This job posting and Location has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.
